title: RANSAC Plane Fitting
hints: Create `std::mt19937 rng(seed)` once and draw 3 indices with `std::uniform_int_distribution<int>(0, n-1)`; redraw until they are distinct.
Plane from 3 points: n = (p2-p1) x (p3-p1). If |n| is ~0 the sample is collinear, so skip it. Otherwise normalise and d = -n.dot(p1).
Score = number of points with |n.dot(p) + d| <= thresh; keep the best. Optional: refit the best inlier set with least squares (centroid + smallest eigenvector), then recompute inliers.
Return false if n < 3, or if no non-degenerate sample was found in `iters` tries.
